description: This file defines three classes that implement data processing steps (Map, Reduce, and Empty) used in a MapReduce pattern. Each class implements the ITransformProcessor interface for specific input and output types, with Process methods performing string splitting, grouping, and identity processing.

classes.name: MapProcessor
classes.description: Performs tokenization of input string into a list of words based on delimiters.

classes.name: ReduceProcessor
classes.description: Aggregates a list of strings into a dictionary counting occurrences, case-insensitively.

classes.name: EmptyProcessor
classes.description: Returns the input dictionary unchanged; acts as a pass-through processor.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes the input data according to the specific processor's logic (splitting, grouping, or identity).
